name: Will Merrick
bio: William Charles Merrick (born 9 April 1993) is an English screen and stage actor. His debut was in the third generation of the BAFTA winning, E4 television series Skins as the character Alo Creevey.

credits.title: Resident Evil
credits.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

credits.title: The Painting & The Statue
credits.overview: Two lonely strangers meet across a crowded room. It just takes one held look, one breathless moment, to bring them completely alive...literally.

credits.title: F1
credits.overview: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed out of retirement to lead a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentor a young hotshot driver—while chasing one more chance at glory.

credits.title: A Matter of Choice
credits.overview: After unexpectedly finding a connection in the waiting room of an assisted-suicide clinic, Mallory and Drystan are left with a choice: do they stay or do they go?

credits.title: Barbie
credits.overview: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

credits.title: A Classic Horror Story
credits.overview: Five people travelling by camper crash into a tree. When they recover, the road they were driving on has been replaced by an impenetrable forest and a wooden house.

credits.title: Ataraxia
credits.overview: A conceptual art project exploring poetry in an alternative, modern way. Similar to a collection of short stories this project assembles a series of video clips - each one entering the distinctive universe of a poem. Seven poems told in seven unique ways.

credits.title: Tic
credits.overview: Dave struggles to keep his Tourette’s on the down-low while on a date with Jess.

credits.title: Swiped
credits.overview: A dating app in the near future promises to bring people together, but old habits die hard.

credits.title: Thanks for the Memories
credits.overview: A curious encounter outside a travel agent pulls Joel Fink into an unusual world where he's offered an even more unusual proposition.

credits.title: Modern Life Is Rubbish
credits.overview: Brought together by their shared love of music, Liam and Natalie reach a breaking point after ten years together, but as they attempt to separate and divide their prized record collection, the very soundtrack of their relationship continually draws them back to one another.

credits.title: The Rack Pack
credits.overview: The 1980s snooker rivalry between Alex “Hurricane” Higgins and Steve “The Nugget” Davis, two very different personalities who helped popularise the sport on TV.
A schoolgirl with amnesia wakes to a deadly ultimatum. Will she get to the library in time to avoid disembowelment?

credits.title: About Time
credits.overview: The night after another unsatisfactory New Year's party, Tim's father reveals to him that the men in their family have the ability to travel through time.
